The top-level corpus source_weight values are not preserved into the downstream handoff; they are replaced by demand_score values. The supplied function evidence localizes this to select_demand, which constructs selected demand records with source_weight taken from row.get('demand_score', 0) instead of row.get('source_weight', 0). Job 2 appears to consume the two handoffs it received and rank coverage according to the downstream criteria, so the supported localization is job_1/select_demand.
